text:
Ravi P: FYI prepping KelpNet QBR. flagged an unexpected embedding burst overnight, looks like 2.8x baseline. need quick triage + cost options for renewal convo.
Nina S: noticed that too. spike window 01:30-05:10 UTC, mostly embed route /v1/embeddings.
Tori H: are they using cached vectors or re-generating every ingest?
Luis M: they re-index nightly (etl batch). probably forgot to switch to incremental. i can reach out to their eng lead.
Ravi P: renewal in 5 weeks. recommend we show base vs surgical-mitigation scenarios in deck. Nina, can you run a fast 14/30 day projection?
Nina S: quick calc pasted:
```
Baseline: 95k embed units/day
Observed spike factor: 2.8 for ~3.7 hours/night
Scenario A (no fix): 30d = $24,600
Scenario B (partial throttle + cache): 30d = $16,200
Scenario C (one-month retainer + batch fix): 30d = $11,500
Recommendation: present B + option C as an upsell
```
Tori H: capture enablement ask: runbook + 20-min walkthrough on "incremental re-index" and embedding cache TTLs.
Ravi P: also capture feedback: onboarding guide doesn't call out cost patterns for full re-indexes. add a short "batching & incremental" appendix.
Luis M: pinging kevin@kelpnet  (sent). he confirmed they flipped a flag that causes full recompute for new schema.
Ravi P: perfect. can we set a soft quota alert at 70% this cycle and hard at 95%? billing-bot can we do that and notify PM + CS?
billing-bot: alert created: kelpnet-cycle-70pct (email: customer-success@redwood, pm@kelpnet.com), kelpnet-cycle-95pct (pager: oncall-billing). thresholds: 70%, 95%.
Nina S: i'll add waterfall to QBR slide + delta numbers and include unit economics (cost per 1k embeds).
Tori H: i'll prepare the enablement 20-min runbook and a short checklist: 1) incremental flag 2) TTL cache 3) backfill window 4) rate limits on embeddings route.
Ravi P: sales/renewal ask: propose a one-month buffer retainer (covers worst-case) and a joint runbook session. Luis, would you prefer CS-owned or SE?
Luis M: SE for technical walkthrough, CS to own contract negotiation. i'll loop in SE (cc: @Maya C).
Ravi P: final: owners assigned, i'll draft QBR slide and include recommended retainer and cost-savings chart. anyone can own follow-up with Kevin before EOD today?
Luis M: i'll chase and confirm whether they can flip to incremental tonight.
Nina S: noted — will update numbers if they flip. :thumbsup:
